description: SYNTHETIC. A paper buy of RY (Royal Bank of Canada, TSX) in a CAD-based IBKR paper account, through the ibkr_paper broker layer. The ibkr/ files are hand-written in the shape of the IBKR Client Portal Web API (GET /portfolio/accounts, /portfolio/{accountId}/summary, /portfolio/{accountId}/positions/0); they are not recorded from any account. The clock is supplied here because that API has no single clock call.
